name: Audio Engine
author: ct
description: Engine audio subsystem: IAudioService implementation (Music/SFX/Ambient buses), the auto-advancing music player and the audio factories (music, sounds, playlists). Replaces the former Core/Audio autoloads — the AudioModInitializer adds nodes named AudioService and MusicPlayer to the scene tree root on the boot Scenes phase, so /root/AudioService keeps resolving.
